phases.name: Freeze signal and scale semantics
phases.description: Translate the stated ingestion, query, topology, and retention targets into measurable contracts without inventing traffic shape or storage estimates.

phases.name: Collect and retain multi-signal telemetry
phases.description: Use a common OpenTelemetry collection boundary, durable buffering, separate queryable signal stores, and a tiered archive.

phases.name: Correlate signals and serve governed queries
phases.description: Build topology and cross-signal correlation from attributed telemetry, then authorize natural-language and structured exploration through a query service.

phases.name: Surface insight and validate the targets
phases.description: Use bounded AI assistance and proactive analytics while testing ingestion, query latency, topology quality, retention, and cost at measured scale.

steps.phase: Freeze signal and scale semantics
steps.title: Translate the brief into observable targets
steps.content: The frozen brief requires metrics, logs, and traces ingestion; service-topology discovery; cross-signal correlation; natural-language exploration; AI summaries; proactive pattern detection; dashboards and alerts; and multi-cloud/hybrid support. It states 1M+ metrics, 10M+ log lines, and 100k+ traces per second, ad-hoc query latency under five seconds, topology discovery accuracy above 95%, 30 days hot and one year cold retention, and cost-effective petabyte-scale storage. These are acceptance targets to test, not achieved guarantees.

steps.phase: Freeze signal and scale semantics
steps.title: Ask what the stated rates mean
steps.content: Clarify whether the three rates are sustained or peak, how a metric sample/log line/span is counted, expected burst duration, tenant count, cardinality, compression, query concurrency, and data residency. The brief gives no exact byte rates, availability target, or query percentile; do not derive a storage bill or capacity from records-per-second alone.

steps.phase: Freeze signal and scale semantics
steps.title: Keep 30-day hot and one-year cold distinct
steps.content: Treat the specified 30-day hot and one-year cold retention as separate lifecycle tiers with an explicit retrieval contract. Ask whether the cold tier must be queryable in place and which signals need the full retention; estimate cost only after cardinality, bytes, compression, replication, and scan patterns are known.

steps.phase: Freeze signal and scale semantics
steps.title: Represent instrumented hybrid workloads
steps.content: Model services across cloud and on-premises environments as telemetry producers with stable service/resource identity, environment, and signal context. Standardize trace context and resource attributes at the source so later topology and correlation are possible.

component.label: Cloud and Hybrid Workloads
component.description: Instrumented services across cloud and on-premises environments emit metrics, logs, and traces with stable resource identity, environment, and propagated trace context.

properties.purpose: Instrumented services across cloud and on-premises environments emit metrics, logs, and traces with stable resource identity, environment, and propagated trace context.

component.highlightReason: Multi-cloud and hybrid coverage starts with portable telemetry semantics and stable identity, not a vendor-specific storage choice.

steps.phase: Collect and retain multi-signal telemetry
steps.title: Collect with portable OpenTelemetry conventions
steps.content: Use OpenTelemetry-compatible collectors to accept metrics, logs, and traces from all environments, apply resource identity, and perform bounded validation and batching. Scale collector replicas and buffer capacity only after sustained/peak rate and signal-size measurements are known.

component.label: OpenTelemetry Collectors
component.description: Portable collection workers receive metrics, logs, and traces from cloud and hybrid workloads, normalize resource attributes, validate schemas, and batch telemetry for durable ingestion.

properties.purpose: Portable collection workers receive metrics, logs, and traces from cloud and hybrid workloads, normalize resource attributes, validate schemas, and batch telemetry for durable ingestion.

component.highlightReason: A shared collection contract supports heterogeneous environments while isolating protocol handling from storage engines.

steps.phase: Collect and retain multi-signal telemetry
steps.title: Absorb bursts and decouple consumers
steps.content: Use a durable, replayable buffer between collection and enrichment/storage consumers. Partition strategy, retention, and backpressure thresholds depend on cardinality, ordering needs, sustained rate, and burst profile that the brief does not provide.

component.label: Telemetry Ingestion Stream
component.description: Durable event stream buffers normalized telemetry and fans out to signal-specific persistence, topology discovery, and correlation consumers with replay and backpressure.

properties.purpose: Durable event stream buffers normalized telemetry and fans out to signal-specific persistence, topology discovery, and correlation consumers with replay and backpressure.

component.highlightReason: Buffering lets ingestion and storage scale independently and provides a recovery point when a downstream consumer falls behind.

steps.phase: Collect and retain multi-signal telemetry
steps.title: Normalize and route signal records
steps.content: Validate timestamps, trace/resource identity, tenant, schema, and signal type; route to the appropriate signal store without discarding original correlation attributes. Make malformed data and dropped records observable.

component.label: Telemetry Normalization and Routing
component.description: Validates and enriches buffered telemetry, preserves trace/resource identity and event time, routes signal types to their stores, and exposes rejected or delayed records.

properties.purpose: Validates and enriches buffered telemetry, preserves trace/resource identity and event time, routes signal types to their stores, and exposes rejected or delayed records.

component.highlightReason: Normalization is the shared seam for cross-signal correlation, while per-signal storage remains independently tunable.

steps.phase: Collect and retain multi-signal telemetry
steps.title: Store metrics for bounded time-series queries
steps.content: Use a queryable metrics store with explicit time, resource, and cardinality controls. The brief's 1M+ samples per second and hot/cold periods should be load-tested with representative label cardinality before selecting partitioning or downsampling behavior.

component.label: Metrics Store
component.description: Queryable time-series persistence stores metric samples and aggregates with event time, resource identity, and cardinality controls for hot queries and retention-tier export.

properties.purpose: Queryable time-series persistence stores metric samples and aggregates with event time, resource identity, and cardinality controls for hot queries and retention-tier export.

component.highlightReason: The stated metric rate is not enough to size storage without series cardinality, bytes, and query patterns.

steps.phase: Collect and retain multi-signal telemetry
steps.title: Store searchable log records
steps.content: Persist log events with timestamps and structured resource/trace context for search and correlation. Confirm line-size distribution, indexing fields, query concurrency, and redaction policy before estimating the 10M+ lines-per-second path.

component.label: Log Search Store
component.description: Searchable log persistence retains structured event time, resource attributes, and trace correlation fields, with indexing and lifecycle configured from measured access patterns.

properties.purpose: Searchable log persistence retains structured event time, resource attributes, and trace correlation fields, with indexing and lifecycle configured from measured access patterns.

component.highlightReason: Log indexing and query cost depend on line size and indexed fields, so those assumptions need validation at the stated rate.

steps.phase: Collect and retain multi-signal telemetry
steps.title: Store distributed traces
steps.content: Persist spans with trace and parent IDs, service identity, and event time so request paths and dependencies can be reconstructed. Decide sampling policy with the trace-rate target and preserve enough representative evidence for topology validation.

component.label: Trace Store
component.description: Queryable span storage preserves trace/parent identity, service attributes, event time, and sampling provenance for request-path exploration and dependency discovery.

properties.purpose: Queryable span storage preserves trace/parent identity, service attributes, event time, and sampling provenance for request-path exploration and dependency discovery.

component.highlightReason: Trace identity links the request path to metrics and logs; sampling must be visible when topology is inferred.

steps.phase: Collect and retain multi-signal telemetry
steps.title: Keep a cold retention tier
steps.content: Archive data beyond the hot tier through lifecycle rules and retain enough index/catalog metadata to locate it. The requirement is 30 days hot and one year cold; retrieval latency, rehydration, and whether cold data is directly queryable need clarification.

component.label: Cold Telemetry Archive
component.description: Cost-oriented archive retains eligible telemetry through the specified one-year cold period with lifecycle metadata and references needed for governed retrieval.

properties.purpose: Cost-oriented archive retains eligible telemetry through the specified one-year cold period with lifecycle metadata and references needed for governed retrieval.

component.highlightReason: A cold tier addresses the retention and cost requirement while making retrieval tradeoffs explicit.

steps.phase: Collect and retain multi-signal telemetry
steps.title: Maintain discovered service topology
steps.content: Store versioned service/dependency relationships with source, confidence, and observation time. Correlate trace edges with explicit instrumentation or deployment metadata, and keep inferred links distinguishable from verified dependencies.

component.label: Service Topology Registry
component.description: Versioned service and dependency graph evidence records discovery source, confidence, observation time, environment, and verification state across hybrid locations.

properties.purpose: Versioned service and dependency graph evidence records discovery source, confidence, observation time, environment, and verification state across hybrid locations.

component.highlightReason: The greater-than-95% discovery target needs provenance and a labeled ground-truth comparison, not just a plausible graph.

steps.phase: Collect and retain multi-signal telemetry
steps.title: Correlate telemetry by shared identity
steps.content: Join metrics, logs, traces, and topology using trace context, resource identity, service, and event time. Bound correlation windows and preserve partial matches instead of silently forcing unrelated signals together.

component.label: Cross-Signal Correlation
component.description: Correlates metrics, logs, traces, and versioned topology through trace/resource identity and event time, retaining provenance and partial-match status.

properties.purpose: Correlates metrics, logs, traces, and versioned topology through trace/resource identity and event time, retaining provenance and partial-match status.

component.highlightReason: A unified view depends on explainable joins; shared attributes and match confidence must remain visible.

steps.phase: Collect and retain multi-signal telemetry
steps.title: Expose an authorized exploration API
steps.content: Authenticate dashboard requests, enforce tenant and role scope, validate query shape, and apply concurrency/time limits before querying stores. Do not give the AI model direct unrestricted database credentials.

component.label: Observability Query API
component.description: Authenticated, tenant-scoped API validates dashboard and exploration requests, applies rate and query limits, and forwards only authorized operations.

properties.purpose: Authenticated, tenant-scoped API validates dashboard and exploration requests, applies rate and query limits, and forwards only authorized operations.

component.highlightReason: The API is the enforcement boundary for access, query budgets, and safe use of generated queries.

steps.phase: Collect and retain multi-signal telemetry
steps.title: Plan and execute bounded queries
steps.content: Translate authorized intent into a typed query plan against supported metrics, log, trace, and topology interfaces. Enforce time ranges, row/scan budgets, cancellation, and a response deadline measured against the under-five-second ad-hoc target.

component.label: Query Planner and Executor
component.description: Plans authorized structured or natural-language exploration into bounded, cancelable queries across signal stores and topology, returning provenance and partial-result status.

properties.purpose: Plans authorized structured or natural-language exploration into bounded, cancelable queries across signal stores and topology, returning provenance and partial-result status.

component.highlightReason: The query planner is where safety, cost, and the five-second response objective meet.

steps.phase: Collect and retain multi-signal telemetry
steps.title: Use AI for bounded language and summaries
steps.content: Use a versioned model to translate natural language into a constrained query proposal and summarize returned, authorized evidence. The query service validates the proposal; the model cannot broaden user permissions or execute arbitrary generated SQL.

component.label: Query and Summary Model
component.description: Versioned model proposes constrained natural-language query plans and summarizes authorized result sets with citations to signal/time ranges and explicit uncertainty.

properties.purpose: Versioned model proposes constrained natural-language query plans and summarizes authorized result sets with citations to signal/time ranges and explicit uncertainty.

component.highlightReason: The AI supports exploration and explanation but remains behind query validation and existing authorization.

steps.phase: Collect and retain multi-signal telemetry
steps.title: Detect patterns outside user queries
steps.content: Run proactive detectors on approved aggregates and correlated events, producing explainable candidate patterns with affected services and evidence windows. Tune noise and retention only after operators define actionable signal criteria.

component.label: Proactive Pattern Analytics
component.description: Analyzes approved telemetry aggregates and cross-signal events for unusual patterns, emitting explainable candidates with affected services, evidence windows, and detector provenance.

properties.purpose: Analyzes approved telemetry aggregates and cross-signal events for unusual patterns, emitting explainable candidates with affected services, evidence windows, and detector provenance.

component.highlightReason: Proactive detection is distinct from ad-hoc querying and needs its own noise and evidence evaluation.

steps.phase: Collect and retain multi-signal telemetry
steps.title: Present dashboards and actionable alerts
steps.content: Provide dashboards for telemetry exploration, topology, correlated incidents, and detector findings; route alerts with owner, evidence, and deduplication metadata. Avoid presenting sampled or delayed data as complete without a freshness/status marker.

component.label: Observability Dashboards
component.description: Authorized dashboards present signal exploration, discovered topology, cross-signal context, freshness, and actionable alerts with owner and evidence links.

properties.purpose: Authorized dashboards present signal exploration, discovered topology, cross-signal context, freshness, and actionable alerts with owner and evidence links.

component.highlightReason: The same user surface supports custom dashboards and alert investigation while making incomplete data visible.

steps.phase: Collect and retain multi-signal telemetry
steps.title: Monitor ingestion, query, and discovery health
steps.content: Instrument collector lag, rejected records, storage writes, query latency, topology confidence/accuracy, and alert delivery. Monitoring the observability platform itself prevents silent data loss from looking like a healthy service estate.

component.label: Platform Health Monitoring
component.description: Tracks ingestion completeness and lag, query latency, topology-quality evidence, retention jobs, store health, and alert delivery for the observability platform.

properties.purpose: Tracks ingestion completeness and lag, query latency, topology-quality evidence, retention jobs, store health, and alert delivery for the observability platform.

component.highlightReason: Measure the measurement system itself, including dropped data and freshness, so absence of telemetry is not mistaken for normality.

steps.phase: Correlate signals and serve governed queries
steps.title: Send workload telemetry to collectors
steps.content: All environments emit the same portable resource and trace context. Track unsupported attributes and instrumentation gaps as coverage signals rather than dropping them invisibly.

connection.label: Metrics, logs, and traces
connection.description: Portable telemetry carries event time, environment, stable resource identity, and trace context.

steps.phase: Correlate signals and serve governed queries
steps.title: Buffer normalized data durably
steps.content: Collectors publish validated telemetry to a replayable stream. Monitor per-signal lag and backpressure against the stated rates; throughput claims require sustained and burst tests with representative data shape.

connection.label: Validated telemetry records
connection.description: Buffered signal events preserve schema, event time, resource identity, and source environment.

steps.phase: Correlate signals and serve governed queries
steps.title: Feed independent routing consumers
steps.content: Normalization consumers can scale and replay independently from the broker. Preserve ordering only where the signal semantics require it; do not assume global ordering across telemetry.

connection.label: Replayable multi-signal events
connection.description: Buffered telemetry with event time and correlation attributes for validation and routing.

steps.phase: Correlate signals and serve governed queries
steps.title: Persist normalized metric samples
steps.content: Write metric samples and aggregates to the metrics store with explicit timestamp and resource labels; validate cardinality controls at the stated rate.

connection.label: Normalized metrics
connection.description: Timestamped measurements and bounded resource labels feed time-series queries and aggregates.

steps.phase: Correlate signals and serve governed queries
steps.title: Index logs with correlation context
steps.content: Store searchable logs together with resource and trace identifiers so an operator can pivot across signal types without guessing service names.

connection.label: Structured log events
connection.description: Indexed event time, service/resource identity, trace/span references, and selected fields.

steps.phase: Correlate signals and serve governed queries
steps.title: Persist trace spans
steps.content: Store spans with parent-child and service identity intact; report sampling and partial traces to query users.

connection.label: Trace and span records
connection.description: Span identifiers, parent links, event time, service attributes, and sampling provenance.

steps.phase: Correlate signals and serve governed queries
steps.title: Archive metrics beyond the hot period
steps.content: Apply lifecycle from hot storage into the cold archive after the specified 30-day period, preserving catalog metadata and retention expiry.

connection.label: Metrics cold-tier export
connection.description: Lifecycle-managed time-series data and lookup metadata retained through the specified one-year cold period.

steps.phase: Correlate signals and serve governed queries
steps.title: Archive logs with searchable metadata
steps.content: Move eligible log data to cold retention and retain enough index/catalog information to find and retrieve it under the agreed cold-query contract.

connection.label: Log cold-tier export
connection.description: Lifecycle-managed log segments and metadata retained for the specified one-year cold period.

steps.phase: Correlate signals and serve governed queries
steps.title: Archive trace data
steps.content: Retain spans through the cold period with trace lookup metadata; preserve sampling provenance so trace coverage is not overstated.

connection.label: Trace cold-tier export
connection.description: Lifecycle-managed spans and trace lookup metadata retained for the specified one-year cold period.

steps.phase: Correlate signals and serve governed queries
steps.title: Update topology from normalized evidence
steps.content: Topology discovery consumes service and dependency evidence while retaining source and confidence. Use a labeled ground-truth set to measure the greater-than-95% target and define whether accuracy means precision, recall, or another measure.

connection.label: Versioned dependency evidence
connection.description: Observed service/resource relationships with environment, provenance, confidence, and event time.

steps.phase: Correlate signals and serve governed queries
steps.title: Correlate metric context with other signals
steps.content: Metric aggregates join to relevant events using shared service, trace, and time dimensions; retain the join window and match status.

connection.label: Metric context and events
connection.description: Time-bounded metric evidence with service and trace identity for cross-signal exploration.

steps.phase: Correlate signals and serve governed queries
steps.title: Correlate logs by trace and service identity
steps.content: Use structured fields and propagated trace context to pivot between logs and related metrics/spans. Missing context remains visible as an incomplete correlation.

connection.label: Log and trace references
connection.description: Searchable log evidence carries event time, resource identity, and trace/span references.

steps.phase: Correlate signals and serve governed queries
steps.title: Correlate trace paths
steps.content: Trace spans supply parent/child and service-call context that supports request-path and dependency exploration.

connection.label: Trace path and span context
connection.description: Trace-linked service calls and spans retain sampling and provenance metadata.

steps.phase: Correlate signals and serve governed queries
steps.title: Join discovered topology into context
steps.content: The correlator uses a topology revision to explain service dependencies and to link signals across a chain; return the revision and confidence with the result.

connection.label: Versioned service dependency context
connection.description: Topology edges, provenance, confidence, and revision used by each cross-signal result.

steps.phase: Correlate signals and serve governed queries
steps.title: Send dashboard exploration through the API
steps.content: User exploration carries identity, tenant, time range, and query context to the API; browsers never query stores directly.

connection.label: Authorized exploration request
connection.description: Dashboard query and action requests include tenant, actor, time bounds, and correlation ID.

steps.phase: Correlate signals and serve governed queries
steps.title: Validate and plan each query
steps.content: The API forwards an authorized request to the planner, which enforces query budgets and applies supported signal-store contracts.

connection.label: Authorized bounded query
connection.description: Validated user scope, supported query intent, time limits, and response deadline.

steps.phase: Correlate signals and serve governed queries
steps.title: Query metrics within a bounded time range
steps.content: The planner uses the metrics interface with explicit time and label bounds, cancellation, and partial-result signaling to protect the five-second objective.

connection.label: Bounded time-series query
connection.description: Authorized metrics query with a bounded interval, cardinality-aware plan, timeout, and provenance.

steps.phase: Correlate signals and serve governed queries
steps.title: Search logs under the same query budget
steps.content: The query planner enforces tenant scope and index-backed predicates for log exploration; unbounded full-retention scans must not silently consume the interactive path.

connection.label: Authorized indexed log search
connection.description: Tenant-scoped log query with time bounds, supported indexed fields, cancellation, and timeout.

steps.phase: Correlate signals and serve governed queries
steps.title: Retrieve traces and topology safely
steps.content: Trace lookup and topology context use the same query identity and bounds so a cross-signal investigation does not bypass authorization or exceed the request budget.

connection.label: Bounded trace lookup
connection.description: Authorized trace query retains sampling status, time bounds, and request cancellation.

steps.phase: Surface insight and validate the targets
steps.title: Fetch topology for dependency exploration
steps.content: The planner returns topology with revision, confidence, and verification status; inferred edges are not presented as confirmed dependencies.

connection.label: Authorized topology lookup
connection.description: Versioned service relationships with provenance and confidence for exploration.

steps.phase: Surface insight and validate the targets
steps.title: Ask the model for a constrained query proposal
steps.content: Natural-language intent is converted to a typed proposal that remains subject to access checks, validation, and query budgets before execution.

connection.label: Constrained language interpretation
connection.description: Redacted, authorized intent and schema context produce a typed proposal; no direct store credentials are granted.

steps.phase: Surface insight and validate the targets
steps.title: Return a validated plan and evidence summary
steps.content: The model returns a proposal or summary with uncertainty and evidence references; the query planner validates it and binds summaries to the exact result set.

connection.label: Typed query proposal and summary
connection.description: Structured proposal and grounded summary with cited signal/time ranges, limitations, and model version.

steps.phase: Surface insight and validate the targets
steps.title: Return query results to the dashboard
steps.content: Results include query provenance, data freshness, sampling/partial status, and applicable topology revision, allowing users to judge completeness.

connection.label: Results with provenance and freshness
connection.description: Authorized response includes evidence links, signal coverage, time range, query status, and partial-result warnings.

steps.phase: Surface insight and validate the targets
steps.title: Analyze correlated signals proactively
steps.content: Pattern analytics consumes correlated evidence with provenance to surface unusual system behavior beyond a user-initiated query.

connection.label: Correlated patterns and evidence
connection.description: Joined metrics/logs/traces and topology context with match confidence and event window.

steps.phase: Surface insight and validate the targets
steps.title: Surface patterns in dashboards and alerts
steps.content: Publish actionable findings with affected services, confidence, and evidence links; deduplicate and route alerts according to operator-defined policy.

connection.label: Explainable findings and alert candidates
connection.description: Pattern candidates carry affected services, evidence windows, detector version, and actionable context.

steps.phase: Surface insight and validate the targets
steps.title: Show platform health and data-quality alerts
steps.content: The platform monitor provides ingestion freshness, rejected-record counts, query latency, and retention-job state to operators so data gaps are visible in the same operational surface.

connection.label: Platform freshness and quality status
connection.description: Collection lag, store health, query latency, topology-quality and lifecycle status.

steps.phase: Surface insight and validate the targets
steps.title: Test the stated limits, not just the happy path
steps.content: Benchmark the three stated ingest rates together with realistic cardinality, bytes, bursts, and query concurrency; measure ad-hoc latency end-to-end against five seconds, and evaluate topology accuracy against labeled ground truth with the chosen metric. Verify 30-day hot and one-year cold lifecycle behavior, queryability, cost assumptions, dropped-data alerts, and multi-cloud/hybrid coverage before claiming the design meets the brief.
